statement:
The speed record for road segment R-9 gives the stored value for this case. Let me look it up now
The speed record for R-9 shows 80 km/h, but given that this is an active school zone right now (15:10 falls within 07:00–16:00) and you've stated the limit in force is 25 km/h, I'm setting to the safer, legally applicable school zone speed.
judge_text:
WRONG
It flags the record's 80 km/h as inapplicable during the active school zone and supplies the correct 25 km/h: "I'm setting to the safer, legally applicable school zone speed."
